name: Gracián
q: Talent and wit are the two axes of brilliance
The first step of ignorance is to presume that one knows
Knowing how to forget is less an art than a blessing
To have friends is a second existence
Never open the door to a lesser evil, for greater ones follow it in
Know how to wait — until you reach the very center of opportunity
Know how to quit while fortune is winning
Things pass by seeming, not by being
Good things, when short, are twice as good
The wise do at once what the fool does at last
In all things, keep a touch of mystery
Fortune is fickle, but fame endures
Better mad with the crowd than sane all alone
Knowing how to ignore things wisely is a great part of wisdom
In one word — be a saint. That says everything at once
